# YourDictionary.com

> > A comprehensive online language reference providing dictionary definitions, example sentences, synonyms, antonyms, and thesaurus entries for English vocabulary and phrases.

YourDictionary.com offers extensive language resources including real-world sentence examples demonstrating proper word and phrase usage, plus detailed synonym and antonym collections to help users understand and use English vocabulary effectively.

## Key Topics

- sentence examples
- language reference
- dictionary definitions
- vocabulary building
- phrase usage
- synonyms and antonyms
- thesaurus
- example sentences
- English language
- word meanings
- contextual usage
- language learning

## Thesaurus & Synonyms

- [Creation Synonyms: 55 Synonyms and Antonyms for Creation](https://thesaurus.yourdictionary.com/creation): 55 synonyms and antonyms for "creation" including origination, production
- [Constant Synonyms: 157 Synonyms and Antonyms for Constant](https://thesaurus.yourdictionary.com/constant): 157 synonyms and antonyms for "constant" including perpetual, incessant
